3. In the above picture:
   i. $\text{Ni}$ is corroded
   ii. $\text{Fe}$ acts as an anode
   iii. Exchange of electron occurs

Which is correct?

- a. i and ii
- b. ii and iii
- c. i and iii
- iv. i, ii and iii

4. Which of the followings acts as an oxidant in the dry cell?

- a. $\text{Zn}$ rod
- b. $\text{MnO}_2$
- c. Carbon rod
- d. $\text{NH}_4^+$

5. What is the name of the process of giving metallic coating on a different metal through electrolysis?

- a. Volcanizing
- b. Metal purification
- c. Galvanizing
- d. Electroplating

6. Which of the followings is used for striking a nucleus during a nuclear reaction?

- a. Proton
- b. Electron
- c. Positron
- d. Neutron

7. Electrolysis of an aqueous solution of $\text{NaCl}$ with platinum electrode produces-
   i. Hydrogen gas
   ii. Chlorine gas
   iii. Sodium hydroxide solution

Which is correct?

- a. i & ii
- b. ii & iii
- c. i & iii
- d. i, ii & iii
